claims.evidence: The witness identified the model name on the camera body in photos 0 and 1.
The witness confirmed the identity as a mirrorless camera and the model is known for this design.
This is a technical specification of the model that cannot be confirmed through photos of the exterior.

risks.risk: The image sensor may be scratched, dusty, or have fungus.
risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the sensor with the lens/body cap removed.
risks.if_unproven: as having a damaged sensor requiring professional cleaning or replacement.

risks.risk: The rear LCD screen may be cracked or have dead pixels.
risks.proof: A photo of the LCD screen powered on and displaying a menu or image.

risks.risk: The camera may have a very high shutter count, indicating heavy use.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the shutter count from an EXIF data reader using the last photo taken.
risks.if_unproven: as being near the end of its mechanical life.

risks.risk: The camera or lens may have internal electronic or mechanical faults.
risks.proof: A video showing the camera powering on, autofocusing, and capturing a photo.

proof_requests: Photo of the image sensor without the body cap.
Photo of the rear LCD screen while the camera is powered on.
A screenshot showing the current shutter count.
A short video of the camera taking a photo and the lens focusing.
response.reason: The witness has clearly identified the specific model and components, allowing for a valuation based on its worst-case functional condition.
